items.html: And behold, AVI clothe from the throat of Arich until the navel of his heart, as mentioned in the Idra — that it did not say “the navel of the body” but “of the heart,” which is his exact half, as above. And when you evaluate the place of their breasts, you will find that they are in the middle of this place that extends from the throat to the navel of his heart. Therefore the aspect of the breasts was there, above, in the chest, and not below, in the belly, in the place of pregnancy.
